scope: Documentation of source contracts at the immutable source pin. Current means that pin. No application change or audio/device acceptance.

count_units.warning: 262 index/name/range matches are descriptor metadata, not DSP fidelity. Five mixer descriptor rows expand over five parts.

evidence_limits.source_mapping: All 28 referenced source paths verified against exact public Git tree/blob bytes.
evidence_limits.prior_verification: Prior reported C semantics, metadata extraction and targeted Node assertions completed with exit 0. Not rerun here; investigator scripts are not distributed in this pair.
evidence_limits.acceptance: Source claims only. No browser, device, MIDI, audio, performance, SDK/native build or product acceptance.
evidence_limits.export: Nonempty doc.sound rejects project export. Fail-closed behavior does not establish device corruption.
evidence_limits.preservation: Preserve original engines, approved gain, legacy drafts and untouched factory precision.

findings.title: Chicago positions and envelopes are stale
findings.claim: The catalog exposes 32 historical positions while the current Chicago contract has 22 controls. For example, local Cutoff at index 0 does not describe current macro 0, Wave. Independent amp/filter envelope edits also do not describe the current Env A/D/S/R macro family. The prior investigation reported coupled envelope semantics; its standalone check specifically reported Env Attack changing both filter and amp, without independently exercising every A/D/S/R macro. Directly reusing the old indexes would reinterpret intent; no such device adapter is currently active.
findings.acceptance: Affected-path acceptance: a versioned descriptor family must give every current ID one canonical key, project selectors through the current q127 mapping, and preserve coupled envelopes and FX 17–19 identities. Legacy keys need explicit review or rejection with the original draft retained. One sound transaction must preserve Undo/Redo.

findings.title: Miami selectors and extension IDs are stale
findings.claim: The editor labels wave value 1 Square. The prior standalone semantic check reported that current q1 still selects Triangle; the descriptor declaration alone does not establish that result. Current carrier, XMod and wobble selectors have 3, 4 and 4 states. The 18-ID current contract has no IDs 18–22 for the local AAtt/ADec/ASus/ARel/BassSpl extensions.
findings.acceptance: Affected-path acceptance: all current shapes must be reachable at their actual q positions; q1 must not be labelled Square. Unsupported extension keys need explicit legacy handling and must never silently become current macros. Preserve original program mapping and untouched factory precision.

findings.title: Performance inputs are not saved patch edits
findings.claim: PBend is disabled in the editor, but Miami Damper/17 and historical Chicago Damp/31 remain editable as global sound values. The current contract reserves each engine's final two controls for performance; patch writes reject them and restore supplies neutral bend/damper. Chicago arp IDs 13–16 remain saved patch macros with live-keyboard behavior.
findings.acceptance: Affected-path acceptance: exclude performance IDs from patch edits. Any local performance sketch must be explicitly non-exportable. Retain stored arp semantics.

findings.title: Juno and Drone are unsupported by the editor
findings.claim: Firmware exposes 18 Juno and 8 Drone controls, including performance inputs. The editor only admits Chicago/Miami and the adapter rejects Juno/Drone project identities. This is an editor coverage limit.
findings.acceptance: Affected-path acceptance for any later extension: engine selection, key namespaces, validation and stated project support must agree. Keep final two controls performance-only and preserve the one-Miami-context guard without applying it to Juno/Drone. Preserve approved original engines and gain.

findings.title: Sound export fails closed; admitted original ranges lag firmware
findings.claim: Import keeps sound opaque and leaves `doc.sound={}`; any nonempty `doc.sound` rejects project export. Even admitted raw revision/stream 13 projects reject Chicago factories 55–80 and FxType 7–11: the adapter uses 55 factories/max 6 while current firmware uses 81/max 11. Unsupported identities, streams 14/15 and extended-rate data remain rejected.
findings.acceptance: Affected-path acceptance: keep rejection until an independently reviewed original-cell/edit-mask adapter exists. State an explicit conversion matrix, align admitted IDs/ranges, retain opaque bytes on rejection and preserve unedited factory floats. **Fail-closed sound export is not a device corruption claim.**

findings.title: Numeric metadata omits choices and dependent meanings
findings.claim: The 248 matching non-synth rows do not encode all control meaning. Drum Dist 0 means Diode, shared FX Dist 0 means Off; BREAK Pitch position 12 means zero semitones. 808 Sound selects the voice that later pots edit, while Clap Attack always targets maracas. Master COMP/FILTER update dependent controls; independent draft integers do not simulate that state.
findings.acceptance: Affected-path acceptance: show exact choices/units and selected voice/part dependencies. Distinguish pot positions from physical values. Preserve BREAK Rev/Dly aliases at `mix/4/1` and `mix/4/2`; translate editor part order 2/3/0/1/4 before any future firmware dispatch. Any later dependent-write implementation must make one Undo transaction.

findings.title: BREAK Slice mode has a historical meaning
findings.claim: The local 0/1 toggle means GM36–43/note%8. Firmware instead packs independent A/B count codes: 0=8, 1=4, 2=16, 3=32 slices. The adapter rejects nonzero packed counts on import and local mode 1 on export.
findings.acceptance: Affected-path acceptance: label the historical sketch accurately or provide a separately versioned exact A/B count representation. Represent or visibly reject 4/8/16/32 intent and retain unchanged unsupported bytes. The old toggle is not a count-code adapter.

local_lifecycle.meaning: act -> DraftStore.edit -> validateDraft -> snapshot/history revision -> queued SafeDraftStorage save. Undo/Redo restores document snapshots. In-memory assertions do not establish browser storage acceptance.

project_conversion.meaning: readDraft leaves sound={} and retains raw sound bytes only in ProjectDraft provenance; any nonempty doc.sound rejects project export. Engine reassignment also rejects export. Only BREAK pattern fields 0..11 map to project bytes (and only within admitted project formats).

firmware_patch.meaning: Current synth patch is 32 bytes: original macro display bytes, edit mask, OS/schema/kind/factory metadata. Untouched factory floats are not equivalent to rounded display bytes. Final two controls are performance-only; patch restore supplies neutral bend/damper.

contracts.claims: Source parity only. No current local sound key dispatches to firmware. Direct-index comparisons below diagnose descriptors; they do not claim a bad MIDI/device message was sent.
